column1: # The provider half, as it is shipped. `blocking` records whether Mastra Code
# reads exit code 2 from this row's command as a refusal of the agent's own work,
# which is what decides whether the installed command carries the `|| true` guard.
# One row moved event against upstream. Herdr binds the session on SessionStart;
# on Mastra Code 0.38.0 that event's payload carries the literal "session-init"
# rather than a thread id, so the binding is on AgentStart, which carries the real
# one. mastracode.go records the mechanism and the capture that measured it.
